title: Hilbert's Third Problem for Spherical and Hyperbolic Scissors Congruence
exact_target: In spherical and hyperbolic three-dimensional geometry, do volume and the Dehn invariant together completely determine scissors congruence?

sources.citation: Neumann, Hilbert's 3rd Problem and invariants of 3-manifolds, Geom. Topol. Monogr. 1 (1998), 383-411.
